reason: The cited evidence shows that coherent precipitates can strengthen HEAs (E2, E3) and that coherent L12 precipitates cause negligible magnetic pinning (E1), but none of the passages involve Nb doping, the specific (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy, or demonstrate crack arrest and caloric preservation by grain-boundary precipitates. The key premises about Nb-rich precipitate formation and its mechanical/caloric effects are unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Coherent nanoscale precipitates can form in high-entropy alloys and enhance strength without sacrificing ductility.
Coherent L12 precipitates do not exert notable magnetic pinning forces on domain walls compared to grain/twin boundaries.
Precipitation-strengthened eutectic HEAs can achieve high strength and ductility simultaneously.
Nb doping will form coherent Nb-rich precipitates along grain boundaries in the target alloy.
Grain-boundary precipitates will arrest cracks and improve compressive strength by at least 50% without degrading caloric response.
